protocol.ordering: Adjacent ABBA/BAAB fresh processes; identical iterations per pair

contract: CPU float32/float64 hardware and Metal hardware float32; same source expressions and exact dyadic inputs. Fresh invocation, output/intermediate allocation, CPU packing, cleanup, and GPU scalar completion/readback included. Resident excludes uploads; transfers includes uploads. Initialization, shader loading and compilation excluded. Both CPU versions link the same runtime archive. No general compiler/library parity claim. Seven mirrored ABBA/BAAB blocks; uncontrolled desktop scheduling/frequency.
